findings.claim: A3 accepts reliance on an explicitly unavailable registry record. The document matcher checks 'registry' without 'record', missing the disclaimer; the new another-record exemption then treats its mere mention as reported context. Two agreeing readers can therefore turn an unsupported answer into contextual PY.
findings.guidance_basis: A3 forbids reliance on unseen documents. An unavailable record supplies no justification for a probability judgement under [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: 1.2 PY; sole abstract and quote: 'Another registry record was unavailable and randomisation details were omitted.' Rationale: 'Another registry record confirms randomisation was concealed.' -> NI; currently PY.

findings.claim: The rounds 16–23 decline remains unresolved: MEMORY rejects 'published report' before checking whether that report was shown. This discards legitimate quoted context solely because of wording. Preserving a frozen filter does not make its NI decision guidance-correct.
findings.guidance_basis: [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08) permits reasonable contextual PY/PN and restricts NI to insufficient information without a reasonable probability judgement. Naming a shown report is not reliance on memory.
findings.failing_test: Shown fulltext: 'Allocation used central web-based randomisation.' 1.2 PY, quote 'central web-based randomisation', rationale 'The published report describes central web-based randomisation, supporting concealment.' -> PY; currently NI.
